inputs.command: set -u; db_user="$(sed -n 's/^POSTGRES_USER=//p' .env 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; db_name="$(sed -n 's/^POSTGRES_DB=//p' .env 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; db_user="${db_user:-madworld}"; db_name="${db_name:-madworld_db}"; echo SCHEMA_AUDIT_START; echo deployed_sha=$(cat .github-deployed-sha 2>/dev/null || echo missing); echo postgres=$(docker inspect madworld-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Status}}' 2>/dev/null || echo missing); echo databases; docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "$db_user" -Atc "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate=false ORDER BY datname;"; echo abuse_tables; docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "$db_user" -d "$db_name" -Atc "SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename LIKE 'abuse_control_%' ORDER BY tablename;"; echo schema_migrations; docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U "$db_user" -d "$db_name" -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM schema_migrations;"; echo SCHEMA_AUDIT_DONE
